SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.parent_id = 1 OR c.id = 1 THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');

SELECT 
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category_id IN (2, 3, 4) -- 手机、电脑、配件
AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');

SELECT 
    p.name,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN oi.qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_qty,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN 1 END) AS valid_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN oi.qty ELSE 0 END) / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN 1 END) AS avg_qty_per_order
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2025-10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS percentage
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) AS month,
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS sales
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2026-10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS percentage
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.city,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.name as category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) as gross_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit ASC
LIMIT 1
